findings.fix: Use sentence-case text at a readable size, or delete the label.
Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.

findings.message: 1 panel shadow(s) heavy enough to read as floating: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7) 0px 40px 90px -40px
findings.fix: Panels sit on the ground: separate them with a fill one step from the ground or a quiet 1px border. A shadow, if any, is under 8% black with a small blur. Real overlays (menus, dialogs, popovers) may float.

findings.message: 39 panel borders are dark against their ground: #ffffff on #0f0f11 (19.15:1) | #ffffff on #17171a (17.89:1) | #ffffff on #17171a (17.89:1)
findings.fix: A panel border is a whisper: about 1.1–1.3:1 against its ground on a light screen (#e5e7eb–#ededed on white), and about 1.2–1.5:1 on a dark one (#1a1a1a on #000, #2e2e2e on #111). Darker lines turn the screen into a grid of boxes; keep the stronger line for controls.

findings.message: 28 text blocks under 11px: Fotó: eBay 10px, Fotó: eBay 10px, Fotó: eBay 10px, Fotó: eBay 10px.
Only 2 of 35 blocks start on the first 1440px screen.
findings.fix: Every block the brief names shows its header and first rows on the first desktop screen: size the headline block to its question, cap long lists with "View all", and put time-sensitive blocks before long tables.

findings.message: 3 card(s) hold a blank band inside: 60px in "Új outfit", 50px in "ELEMZÉS", 50px in "RENDRAKÁS".
findings.fix: A card stretches to its neighbour only when it has content to fill. Keep a legend or a note directly under its chart (only an action or a total may sit at a stretched card's foot), let a short card keep its own height (align-items: start), and let a filtered block shrink to its rows.
An app screen is not a landing page: the title is 18-32px (20-24px on a phone).

findings.message: Large text lies under another element at some scroll position: "Szia, Barátom!" (screen 1, 100% hidden); "Kategóriák" (screen 1, 100% hidden); "Outfitjeid" (screen 1, 100% hidden)
findings.fix: Nothing may sit on top of a headline or statement. Move the picture, shorten the pinned run, or raise the text above it (z-index) and give it a ground.
Remove. Use words or real imagery.
